Michael: Quick check — can we move the nightly SKU bench window earlier tomorrow? Need a full A100/H100/L40S long-ctx sweep before the customer demo.
Anita: What window do we have today?
Jonas: It's currently 03:00-06:00 UTC.
Tara: Ops asked us to avoid 03:30-04:30 due to backups (we hit a clash last week).
Michael: Proposal: shift to 00:00-03:00 UTC so we finish before the backups. That also gives us the rest of the day to triage any regressions. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Lucas: That would work for infra. Only ask: can we split the run so H100/A100 run first, then L40S last? Thermal on L40S spikes overnight.
bench-bot: Next scheduled run: sku-nightly-sweep @ 2298800000 (A100,H100,L40S) — you can create or reschedule with `benchctl schedule`.
Michael: Planned configs: llama2-13b (q4), redwood-7b (fp16), opt-30b (q4) — seq lens: 8192, 16384; batch sizes: 1, 4, 8. Kernel pin: 545.60, CUDA 12.1.
Michael: Example run command:
```
./bench/run --model llama2-13b --quant q4 --seq 8192 --batch 4 --gpu A100 --kernel 545.60
```
Anita: Add prometheus scrape + p99 tail latency histograms to the job so we can capture microbursts. Also enable kv-cache warmup flag for long-ctx.
Jonas: Agree. I'll add a tracing hook: /traces/sku-nightly/<run-id>.
Tara: Ops — any objections to 00:00-03:00? We need a hard no for overlapping backups.
Ops: We can approve 00:00-03:00 but avoid 00:45-01:15 (host housekeeping window). If you split H100/A100 first (00:00-01:30) and L40S after (01:30-03:00) that should be fine.
Michael: Perfect — plan: H100/A100 00:00-01:30, L40S 01:30-03:00 UTC. I'll submit the reschedule and attach the config + kernel pin.
Lucas: I'll queue up the thermal monitor for L40S and the nvlink counters for H100.
bench-bot: Run created: sku-nightly-2298765432-01 (A100,H100 00:00-01:30) and sku-nightly-2298765432-02 (L40S 01:30-03:00). Links: https://benchboard.internal/runs/sku-nightly-2298765432-01
Michael: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up in the morning with the results and any regressions. If you want to add specific workloads, reply here before 23:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
